title: Concept: postMessage with a wildcard target origin
description: A postMessage call that passes a wildcard target origin in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: A wildcard origin sends the payload to whatever document currently occupies the target window, so a frame that navigates elsewhere receives the message, including tokens or account data.
applicability: Account data or tokens delivered to an unexpected origin leak to whoever controls that frame.
risk: The target origin is the only thing that binds a message to a recipient.
